name: Run `pytest api/tests/web/test_web_stack.py` (cwd `api/`) and paste the real summary line — unblocks acceptance of `12cb7d0c` and `6881fc56`
description:
## Why
Card `12cb7d0c` added 3 escalation tests to `api/api/tests/web/test_web_stack.py` (403 lines, `+194/-7`). They are **statically verified but never executed**: the `software_developer` tool set in that shift exposed no shell and no `qa_run_tests`, so the acceptance item "paste the real summary line" could not be met. `6881fc56` (`browser_fetch`) stays unaccepted until it is.

## What to do
1. Run, from the api project root (cwd `api/`): `pytest api/tests/web/test_web_stack.py -q`
   - Note: `api/tests/web/...` is the path **relative to cwd `api/`**. Project-relative it is `api/api/tests/web/test_web_stack.py`. Using the wrong one makes pytest exit **4** ("file or directory not found").
2. Paste the real summary line on `12cb7d0c` as an assistant comment.
3. If any of the 3 new tests fails, do **not** edit `api/codx/junior/web/**` in this card — comment the failure on `12cb7d0c` and create a card for the module defect.

## Acceptance evidence
- Real line pasted on `12cb7d0c`, expected `18 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped` (baseline was 15 passed from `85973d78`; exactly +3 test ids, no parametrisation).
- No `skip`, `xfail`, `--ignore` or `-k` filtering used to reach it.

## Notes
- The three tests are: rendered=True path, fail-closed path (`BrowserUnavailable` **and** `RenderError`), and `validate_url` called twice (pre-load + on `page.url`, private client-side redirect ⇒ `UnsafeUrlError`).
- Tests need no network and no Chromium (Playwright, `safe_get` and `resolve_host` are all faked).
- Owner: `software_developer`.
